note: The MODEL SURFACE the eval harness proves against, pinned. The goldens in test-llm/golden/ pin each tool's prompt, schema and shape; the quality bake pins how good the answers are; the budget file pins what a prompt costs. None of them record WHICH MODEL any of that was true of, so a model id can be bumped in src/lib/llm/models.ts and every one of those records silently starts describing a different model. This file is the missing half: the tags and CLI aliases this app serves through, and the reason each was last accepted. `npm run llm:models:check` fails when src/lib/llm/models.ts declares a model surface this file does not, and test-unit/llm-model-pin.test.mjs runs the same comparison on every build.

pins.provider: claude — Claude Code CLI on the maintainer's subscription (development)
claude — Claude Code CLI, fast tier (development)
gemini — the Google GenAI API (production; what real users are served by)
codex — the Codex CLI on the ChatGPT plan (development, keyless)

excluded.why: a BYOM default, not a model this app serves through. The user picks the model in settings and pays the provider directly, so the harness never proves it and pinning it here would record a claim nothing checks.
the fast-tier half of the same BYOM default — same reason.

acceptance.reason: First pin. Recorded from src/lib/llm/models.ts as it stands, so a model id can no longer move without a build going red. NOT a claim that anything was re-proved: no real-model run backs this entry, and `provenAt` stays null until one does.

unpinnable: A provider changing the model BEHIND a stable alias. `sonnet` and `gemini-3-flash-preview` are pointers; the thing they point at ships without a commit here, and no file in this repository can see that. The weekly `npm run llm:drift` (.github/workflows/llm-drift.yml) is what dates it — it re-proves every registered operation against the configured provider and publishes a pass/fail trail. This file makes the alias itself reviewable; it cannot make it immutable.
Model behaviour, as opposed to model identity. `npm run llm:quality` scores that, and its floor is `npm run llm:quality:check`.
